stem.en: Why can a delta be a good place to farm and also a risky place to live?

text.en: Its soil is poor, but its land is high above the sea.

feedback.en: Delta soil is very fertile, and delta land is low.

text.en: It has no rivers, so crops must be watered by rain.

feedback.en: A delta is full of river channels.

text.en: Its rock is hard, so floods run off quickly.

feedback.en: A delta is made of soft sediment, not hard rock.

text.en: Its river sediment is fertile, but it can flood.

feedback.en: Right. Both come from the river.

explanation.en: The same rivers that bring fertile sediment can also flood the low land. So deltas support crops such as rice and jute, but floods can affect people's lives and work.

hints.en: What does the river bring, and what can it also do?
